column1: # NPC groupings seen on a live server: the fleet a spawn row's `npc_grouping_id`
# put out, one row per observed fleet [V-TQ].
# `npcGroupingID` names a server-side fleet template that is not in the client's
# corpus (docs/re/dungeon-model.md section 5). The rows are read off the AddBalls2
# slims of three TQ recordings: 20261117_122753 (17NOV2026, build 3707965) and
# carries its spawn row's `entityGroupID`, which spawns.tsv maps to the
# npc_grouping_id: the spawns.tsv column. ships: the fleet's type ids,
# space-separated, sorted by type. seen: where it was recorded.
# A spawn row whose grouping has rows draws one of its fleets
# (`npc_gen::dungeon_squads`); one without keeps the budgeted fill [A].
